body:
Note we do have an agenda for Thursday's meeting already:
Review past action items
 Simon will create a spec PR for [Form Submission: Fix the "Double Submit problem" at the spec level](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/5312).
Carryovers from last time
[Simon] [Audit and fix innerHTML scripting disabled parsing behavior for template #10879](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10879)
[Anne/Domenic] [constraint validation for FACE when validation anchor is null #10155](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10155)

Thanks to all those who attending the meeting today:  myself, Joey Arhar, David Baron, Mike Smith, Kurt Catti-Schmidt, Mason Freed, Andy Luhrs, Olli Pettay, Simon Pieters, and Noam Rosenthal.

With the agreement of the attendees, we experimented with using Gemini built in to Meet to scribe the session.

Summary:
- Simon Pieters reported on the ongoing double submit spec PR and raised concerns about inconsistent `innerHTML` scripting behavior in Firefox, Safari, and Chrome, which led to a discussion about potential XSS risks and the use of a counter. 
- Mason Freed proposed renaming the "interest target" API to "interestfor," which Olli Pettay and Simon Pieters agreed with, pending WebKit feedback. 
- Kurt Catti-Schmidt discussed advancing fragment references in `<style>` links to stage two, addressing prior concerns from Anna, and led a discussion with Olli Pettay, Mason Freed, and Noam Rosenthal regarding the liveness and scoping implications, particularly concerning shadow DOM and global scoping needs for streaming SSR as highlighted by Justin and Nolan Lawson, with a decision made for Kurt Catti-Schmidt to proceed with a PR and explore global scoping solutions. 
- Olli Pettay postponed the discussion on command event propagation with Anna and Keith.

Full notes at https://docs.google.com/document/d/1oUBsjVlqZLC9lS--j_OBBnoH7pYS7iRbpZCFaROkGf0/edit?usp=sharing.  (You may need to ask for access, contact cwilso@google.com if there is an issue.)
